news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 21%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹2.72b to ₹2.47b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹13.50 per share to ₹10.70 per share. Net income forecast to grow 40% next year vs 40% growth forecast for Aerospace & Defense industry in India. Consensus price target up from ₹1,375 to ₹1,435. Share price was steady at ₹1,002 over the past week.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited (NSEI:UNIMECH) and Innomech Aerospace Toolings Private Limited signed a definitive agreement to acquire 99.99% stake in Hobel Bellows Co for INR 4.5 billion.
news.body:
Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited (NSEI:UNIMECH) and Innomech Aerospace Toolings Private Limited signed a definitive agreement to acquire 99.99% stake in Hobel Bellows Co for INR 4.5 billion on April 22, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 80 million will be paid by Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited and Innomech Aerospace Toolings Private Limited for the common equity of Hobel Bellows Co. A cash consideration of INR 550 million will be paid by Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited for the non-convertible debt of Hobel Bellows Co. A cash consideration of INR 3.87 billion will be paid by Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited and Innomech Aerospace Toolings Private Limited for the Compulsorily Convertible Debentures of Hobel Bellows Co.
